ideas.title: T1D vs T2D Education Series
ideas.description: Clear, simple posts explaining the differences between Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes. Combat the confusion and stigma.
ideas.notes: So much misinformation out there. People think T1D is caused by diet.

ideas.title: Day in the Life: T1D Parent
ideas.description: Real, unfiltered look at managing a child's T1D - the 3am alarms, school coordination, sports management.
ideas.notes: Show both the struggles and the wins. Normalize the reality.

ideas.title: Tech Evolution Timeline
ideas.description: Visual journey through diabetes tech from the 1990s to today. Celebrate how far we've come.
ideas.notes: Could be really engaging on TikTok with transition effects

ideas.title: AVA Development Diary
ideas.description: Behind-the-scenes content showing AVA's development journey, challenges, breakthroughs.
ideas.notes: People love the authentic journey. Show failures too.

ideas.title: Community Spotlight
ideas.description: Feature other T1D families, their stories, their solutions. Build community.
ideas.notes: Could partner with T1D influencers and advocates

ideas.title: CGM Data Storytelling
ideas.description: Turn glucose graphs into stories - what caused that spike, how we managed that low, celebrating a good day.

ideas.title: Mythbuster Monday
ideas.description: Weekly series debunking diabetes myths and misconceptions

ideas.title: Kids' Perspective Videos
ideas.description: Let kids with T1D share their own stories, tips, and experiences in their own words
ideas.notes: Kids relating to kids is powerful. Need parental permissions.

ideas.title: Quick Tips Series
ideas.description: 15-second practical tips for T1D management - packing supplies, travel tips, restaurant strategies

ideas.title: T1D Parent Support Groups
ideas.description: Create and promote virtual meetups, support groups, resource sharing for T1D families
ideas.notes: Could tie into AVA user community
